testsuite.name: com.chimali.fido2.data.transport.FidoBleGattContractTest

testcase.name: revision bitfield write only accepts exactly 0x20 without prepared write()
control point write is admitted only when revision and notifications are ready()
unauthenticated device receives insufficient authentication ATT error()
revision bitfield read returns 0x20 and supports valid read offset()
write admission silently rejects requests that do not require an ATT response()
device information service uses generic non-identifying product values()
bonding device receives insufficient authentication and can retry after bond completes()
control point length read returns write capacity as two big endian bytes()
connection callbacks enforce one active host and update MTU only for that host()
device information reads are available to active unbonded host with offsets()
second bonded host cannot use the active session()
service definition exposes primary service and four required characteristics()
CCCD descriptor read and write correctly toggles notifications()
control point rejects offset non-zero and prepared writes()
notification sent callback forwards once to listener()
CCCD rejects malformed values and prepared writes without changing subscription()
